correctness.rationale: For each strict branch, the exact 3-level cut formula is proved by counting; graph coarea reduces the operator seminorm to indicators; a convex endpoint optimization proves the global bound, and a strict chamber pair attains it for all n≥3. n=2 is handled separately. Exact rational tests verified 50,375 cardinality combinations, 85,372 independently represented active/cut subsets, 299 attaining pairs, and 3,598 other input pairs. Finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural two-input perturbation modulus for graph BV on all complete graphs is determined sharply, including the first strict amplification at four vertices, explicit witnesses in every dimension, and the asymptotic 5/4 factor. The result distinguishes perturbation amplification from known single-input contraction of the very same maximal operator; it is not a renaming of that known theorem.
